note: Cross-language wire-contract vectors. Consumed by ALL SIX ports: packages/mcp-schemas and packages/verify tests (TS), verify-go, verify-rust, verify-java, and sdk-python. `agentAuthorityPayloads` (DIV §5b) and `platformIntentPayloads` (DIV §5c) were TS-only and are NOT any more — all six build both payloads and all six consume both sections. What remains deliberately TS-only is two sections a relying party's offline verifier has no consumer for: `denialPayloads` (§4.3.3 denial witnesses are DEWP ledger entries checked by leaf recomputation, not Proof Envelopes) and `documentPayloads` (see its own note). Separately, every port's ORDINARY APPROVAL verifier still refuses the `div-agent-authority` and `div-platform-intent` types — those artifacts have their own entry points — and the `receipts` cases agent-authority-refused-by-approval-verifier and platform-intent-refused-by-approval-verifier are where that is pinned; execution-evidence-refused-by-approval-verifier pins the same for the DEWP §4.7 `dewp-execution-evidence` statement. Regenerate ONLY on a deliberate format change.
